rows.text: Krenko doubles your Goblin count every time he taps, so the deck's only real question is how many times you can untap him. Everything else — the sacrifice outlets, the mana Goblins, the two damage enchantments — exists to convert that pile of 1/1s into a kill that does not need combat. And Goblin Recruiter turns the top of your library into a scripted sequence, which is where most of the skill lives.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: {T}: create a token for every Goblin you control. Four Goblins becomes eight, then sixteen. He needs haste or a turn, and then he needs to untap.

rows.name: Thousand-Year Elixir
rows.text: haste for the activation and a separate untap.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: haste the turn he lands, and shroud against the removal that is absolutely coming.

rows.name: Swiftfoot Boots
rows.text: the version that still lets you equip him yourself.

rows.name: Arena of Glory
rows.text: the 21 Mountains help this enter untapped. Pay {R}, tap and exert it to make {R}{R}; spending any of that mana on Krenko, Conspicuous Snoop or Warren Instigator gives that creature haste for the turn. It skips your next untap after exerting, so use the ordinary red-mana ability when haste gains nothing. It does not give haste to Goblins put onto the battlefield by Instigator or Muxus, since you did not cast them with its mana.

rows.name: Hanweir Battlements
rows.text: enters untapped and gives one creature haste for {R} and a tap. Use it on a fresh Krenko or Conspicuous Snoop to activate immediately, including after Warren Instigator or Muxus puts that Goblin onto the battlefield. Giving Instigator haste before combat also enables a same-turn attack. The land produces only colourless mana, and you must leave it untapped plus have a separate red source for the haste ability; it cannot help pay Instigator's {R}{R}. Its meld ability has no partner in this deck.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss + Thornbite Staff + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: equip the Staff to Krenko ({4} — he's a Warrior, so it won't attach itself). Krenko taps for a Goblin per Goblin; sacrifice one to Skirk Prospector; the death untaps Krenko; tap again. The army doubles every lap. Win with Impact Tremors, Purphoros, Pashalik Mons or Goblin Bombardment.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss + Umbral Mantle + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: Krenko taps for Goblins; sacrifice three to Skirk Prospector for {R}{R}{R}; pay the Mantle's {3} to untap Krenko. With four or more Goblins, every lap makes more than it spends — unlimited Goblins and red mana.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: Kiki copies Conscripts, and the copy's enter trigger untaps Kiki — target Kiki itself. Repeat for as many hasty 3/3s as you want, the same turn Kiki lands (it has haste). With Impact Tremors or Purphoros out it is unlimited damage without attacking. Never leave Lightning Greaves on Kiki: shroud stops the Conscripts copy targeting it.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: Kiki copies the Crafter. The copy's champion trigger exiles Kiki; the hasty copy taps for 3 damage; sacrifice it to Goblin Bombardment; Kiki returns untapped — it has haste — and copies the Crafter again. Unlimited 3-damage shots, so this one kills on its own. Skirk Prospector and Ashnod's Altar work as the outlet too. The original Crafter must stay on the battlefield; when it enters you must exile another Goblin or Shaman (champion) or sacrifice it.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Thornbite Staff + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: the Staff attaches itself to Kiki when Kiki enters after it (otherwise equip costs {4}). Kiki copies any nonlegendary creature, you sacrifice a creature to Goblin Bombardment, and the death untaps Kiki. Unlimited loops.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Conspicuous Snoop
rows.text: Recruiter puts Kiki on TOP of your library. Snoop has every activated ability of the Goblin on top, so it copies itself with Kiki's ability — and every hasty copy does the same. Snoop needs haste or a turn in play to start, and most copies end up tapped, so finish with Impact Tremors, Purphoros or Goblin Bombardment. Outside the combo, Snoop lets you cast Goblins straight off the top of your library.

rows.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic + Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: Marvin has every activated ability of your other creatures, so it taps as a second Krenko — and with Kiki-Jiki out, as a second Kiki.

rows.name: Goblin Sharpshooter + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: every Goblin you sacrifice untaps Sharpshooter for another ping — two damage per Goblin, unlimited on an unlimited board.

rows.name: Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: outside the combo it steals a blocker, or untaps your own Krenko for one more activation when you just need one big turn.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: when you already hold Zealous Conscripts, Lightning Crafter or the Staff — Kiki is the piece that turns half a combo into a kill.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: when you're missing two or more pieces. Matron gets Recruiter; Recruiter stacks the rest on top of your library.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: when Thornbite Staff or Umbral Mantle is already out, or when you simply need a board this turn.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Lightning Crafter
rows.text: when Kiki-Jiki is on the battlefield and you have a free outlet — the Crafter is the last piece.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Skirk Prospector
rows.text: when the combo is assembled but nothing will sacrifice for free.

rows.name: Imperial Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: power 2, so the one non-Goblin tutor that still finds Kiki. It also fetches Goblin Recruiter, Conspicuous Snoop or Skirk Prospector — take whichever piece you're missing.

rows.name: Gamble -> Thornbite Staff
rows.text: any card. Priority is roughly the Staff, then Goblin Recruiter, then Kiki-Jiki, then Umbral Mantle — the pieces with no redundancy. Cast it with a full hand: the random discard is then less likely to hit the card you just fetched.

rows.name: Goblin Engineer -> Thornbite Staff
rows.text: puts the Staff into your graveyard, then {R}, tap and sacrifice another artifact puts it onto the battlefield. Engineer needs a turn or haste before it can tap.

rows.name: Goblin Lackey -> Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: when it connects, Krenko or Muxus goes from your hand onto the battlefield for free.

rows.name: Warren Instigator -> Goblin Matron -> Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: an unblocked double-strike hit puts Matron in with the first damage; Matron finds Muxus; the second damage puts Muxus in. It needs Goblins in your hand, not the command zone, and blockers stop it.

rows.name: Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: four cards deep in a deck that is mostly Goblins.

rows.name: Wheel of Fortune
rows.text: a fresh seven when you have emptied your hand, which this deck does by turn four.

rows.name: Skullclamp
rows.text: your tokens are 1/1s, so every clamp is two cards.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: puts ANY number of Goblins from your library on top, in an order you choose. It is a tutor for your next several turns at once — but only if you have a way to reach the stack. There are three.

rows.name: Conspicuous Snoop
rows.text: casts Goblins straight off the top of your library. With Snoop out, a Recruiter stack is effectively your hand. This is the best access tool by a distance.

rows.name: Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: reveals the top four and puts every Goblin among them into your hand. Stack exactly four castable Goblins and it is a four-card draw.

rows.name: Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: reveals the top six and puts every Goblin creature with mana value five or less onto the BATTLEFIELD. Stack five cheap Goblins under whatever you draw and Muxus deploys all of them at once.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Skirk Prospector -> Goblin Warchief -> Krenko, Mob Boss -> Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: with Snoop already out: cast each off the top in order — Prospector makes mana from the Goblins you have, Warchief discounts and hastes the rest, Krenko taps the turn it lands, Muxus deploys what is left.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: going for the combo: Kiki alone on top, then cast Conspicuous Snoop — it copies itself until Impact Tremors, Purphoros or Goblin Bombardment ends the game.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker -> Lightning Crafter -> Skirk Prospector -> Goblin Warchief
rows.text: then cast Muxus: all four enter at once, the Crafter champions Recruiter, and Kiki starts copying the Crafter immediately.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Goblin Matron -> Krenko, Mob Boss -> Skirk Prospector -> Siege-Gang Commander
rows.text: without Snoop, four Goblins you can pay for this turn or next, then Goblin Ringleader puts all four in your hand.
Anything that searches your library shuffles it and wrecks the stack — Goblin Matron, Imperial Recruiter, Gamble and Goblin Engineer. Use those before Recruiter, never after.

rows.name: Impact Tremors
rows.text: one damage to each opponent per creature entering. This is the cheapest way to convert a doubling into a kill.

rows.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
rows.text: two damage to each opponent per creature entering, on an indestructible body.

rows.name: Boggart Shenanigans
rows.text: one damage per Goblin that DIES, which pairs with the sacrifice outlets rather than the token makers.

rows.name: Pashalik Mons
rows.text: the same trigger, and it converts a Goblin into two.

rows.name: Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: free sacrifice outlet that points at faces.

rows.name: Siege-Gang Commander
rows.text: three bodies and a repeatable two-damage cannon.

rows.name: Massive Raid
rows.text: damage equal to your creature count, at instant speed.

rows.name: Goblin Grenade
rows.text: five damage for one mana and a Goblin.

rows.name: Hobgoblin Bandit Lord
rows.text: damage equal to the Goblins that entered this turn — after a Krenko activation that number is enormous.

rows.name: Shared Animosity
rows.text: every attacking Goblin gets +1/+0 per other attacking Goblin. On a board of twenty it is simply lethal.

rows.name: Goblin Chieftain
rows.text: haste for the team and an anthem, which is what makes a fresh Krenko batch able to attack.

rows.name: Goblin Warchief
rows.text: haste plus a discount on every Goblin spell.

rows.name: Combat Celebrant
rows.text: exert for an extra combat, so the whole swarm swings twice.

rows.name: Skirk Prospector
rows.text: sacrifice a Goblin for {R}. It is the outlet, the mana engine and half the combos.

rows.name: Ashnod's Altar
rows.text: two colourless per Goblin, and it is not a Goblin so it survives Goblin-specific hate.

rows.name: Brightstone Ritual
rows.text: {R} for every Goblin ON THE BATTLEFIELD, including your opponents'. After one Krenko activation this is ten or more.

rows.name: Battle Hymn
rows.text: the same idea counting all your creatures.

rows.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling
rows.text: red mana on every spell, and it does not empty between phases.

rows.name: Ruby Medallion
rows.text: red spells cost {1} less — generic mana only, so a one-mana {R} spell still costs {R}.

rows.name: Herald's Horn
rows.text: name Goblin — a discount and a free Goblin off the top most upkeeps.

rows.name: Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx
rows.text: your devotion to red is high; this is often five or six mana.

rows.name: Three Tree City
rows.text: choose Goblin as it enters. Pay {2} and tap it to make red mana equal to your Goblin creature count, including tokens. Activate Krenko first when possible so the larger swarm pays for Muxus, equipment costs or Umbral Mantle activations without sacrificing Goblins. With eight Goblins it produces eight red mana after you pay the two-mana activation cost. Keep a separate way to pay that cost; its ordinary tap ability makes only colourless mana, so it is not an unconditional early red source.

rows.name: Mana Vault
rows.text: three mana on turn one.

rows.name: Lotus Petal
rows.text: free acceleration.

rows.name: Simian Spirit Guide
rows.text: a red mana from your hand for nothing.

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: an uncounterable Goblin that makes all your spells uncounterable while it stays on the battlefield, protecting Krenko and your combo pieces as you cast them. Goblin Matron and Goblin Recruiter can find it, and Ringleader or Muxus can pick it up. It and your other creatures have ward—pay 2 life; opponents can still pay to target them, and it does not protect activated abilities or stop untargeted board wipes.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free with your commander out, and it saves Krenko mid-combo.

rows.name: Abrade
rows.text: three damage or an artifact.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: mono-red's only answer to an enchantment.

rows.name: Vandalblast
rows.text: overloaded, a one-sided artifact wrath.

rows.name: Pyroblast
rows.text: one mana against the blue deck holding a counterspell.

rows.name: Red Elemental Blast
rows.text: the second copy.

rows.name: Goblin Trashmaster
rows.text: an anthem that also eats artifacts.

rows.name: Goblin Chirurgeon
rows.text: regenerates Krenko through a targeted kill spell for the cost of one token.

rows.name: Cavern of Souls
rows.text: name Goblin and Krenko cannot be countered.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep fast mana and a Goblin. Sol Ring, Mana Vault or Lotus Petal into a turn-two or three Krenko is the start that wins; a hand of five-drops is not.

At 35 lands, keep reliable early mana rather than counting on Warren Instigator connecting. It costs {R}{R}, so check your red sources. A Mountain into Arena of Glory can cast it with haste on turn two, but exerting Arena leaves it tapped through your next untap step; take that line when an open opponent and Goblins in hand make the attack worthwhile.

Set up protection before committing Krenko. Hexing Squelcher makes your spells uncounterable, and Cavern of Souls protects Goblin spells cast with its restricted mana; neither stops an opponent countering Krenko's activated ability. Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots helps against targeted removal, while Squelcher's ward only makes opponents pay life. You have less hand filtering now, so keep enough mana and a real route to an engine or refill.
Count the sacrifice outlet before you go off. Thornbite Staff on Krenko does nothing without something to kill a Goblin, and Skirk Prospector is both the outlet and the mana.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: cast it with a plan, not on curve. It is the best card in the deck when you know which four or five cards you want and how you are going to reach them, and close to a blank when you do not.
